name: ProtectedViewWindows
description: A collection of all the ProtectedViewWindow objects that are currently open in Word.
remarks: Use the ProtectedViewWindows property to return the ProtectedViewWindows collection.
example:
MsgBox "There are " & ProtectedViewWindows.Count & _
 " Protected View windows currently open."

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ProtectedViewWindows object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of Protected View windows in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual ProtectedViewWindows object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned.

methods.name: Open
methods.signature: Open(FileName As Variant, [AddToRecentFiles As Variant], [PasswordDocument As Variant], [Visible As Variant], [OpenAndRepair As Variant]) As ProtectedViewWindow
methods.description: Opens the specified document in a new Protected View window.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the document (paths are accepted).

parameters.name: AddToRecentFiles
parameters.description: True to add the file name to the list of recently used files at the bottom of the File menu.

parameters.name: PasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password for opening the document.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: True if the document is opened in a visible window. The default value is True.

parameters.name: OpenAndRepair
parameters.description: True to repair the document to prevent document corruption.
